description: A refresh, a search, and a clean exit. recall/refresh is what the checkpoint capability means: it builds the projection outside the handshake and returns the resulting health rather than an acknowledgement, so a caller learns the coverage of what it just built. recall/shutdown then takes {} and returns {}; the adapter releases its projection, the process closes stdout and exits. Nothing is written after the acknowledgement, which is what the replayer's drain checks.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
